data:
Microsoft delivered a strong fiscal 2024, with revenue rising to $245.1 billion from $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023, growth of 15.7%. Profitability expanded faster than the top line: net income reached $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024, up from $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023. Cash generation was a standout, as operating cash flow climbed to $118.5 billion in fiscal 2024 from $87.6 billion a year earlier. The balance sheet grew substantially, with total assets of $512.2 billion at fiscal 2024 against $412.0 billion at fiscal 2023, while total liabilities rose more modestly to $243.7 billion from $205.8 billion. One point to watch is liquidity on hand: cash and cash equivalents fell to $18.3 billion in fiscal 2024 from $34.7 billion in fiscal 2023, even as operating cash flow strengthened. Overall, the fiscal 2024 results point to durable earnings momentum.

Note: the fact sheet lists net income growth as +21.8%, but $88.1 billion over $72.4 billion works out to about 21.7%. I left the growth rate out of the note rather than repeat a figure that may be wrong. Please confirm which number is correct.
